messages:
Sam (Product): Quick design review request — error analytics / trace viewer UX. Wanted to collect quick takes before we lock the layout for the drilldown panel.
Anya (Design): sharing Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/err-analytics_v3 — main changes are side-by-side stack + request timeline, and a collapsible correlation-id pane.
Mike (Eng): looks good. two implementation notes: 1) correlation IDs should be copy-to-clipboard with toast, 2) export action needs rate-limit protection (we've hit S3 export storms).
Asha (Accessibility): a few nits: contrast on the stack frame badges at small sizes (WCAG AA fail), keyboard focus styles on the timeline scrubber, and descriptive aria-label for the "Export" menu.
Anya (Design): noted — will bump badge contrast and add visible focus ring. For export menu label I'm thinking: "Export trace data (JSON/HAR)" — thoughts?
Mike (Eng): prefer explicit: "Export trace JSON" + secondary for HAR. Also include a small modal that warns about PII if users request full payload export.
Sam (Product): modal copy suggestion: "Exporting full payloads may include sensitive data. Only export traces you are authorized to access." add a link to policy.
Asha (Accessibility): modal needs role=dialog, focus trap, and first focus on the confirm button when opened. Also keyboard shortcut to close (Esc).
Anya (Design): UX question: do we surface correlation ID as a pill in the header, or hide behind a kebab menu? We want quick copy for support teams.
Mike (Eng): surface it prominently in header with "Copy ID" action and small chevron to reveal history of related requests. Backend can return related IDs via /traces?corr=xxx endpoint.
Sam (Product): +1. Also request drilldown should show breadcrumb: Service > Route > Request ID to help SREs.
Anya (Design): I'll update prototype to show header pill + inline copy icon + history flyout. Will also add an "Export" primary action with tiny down caret controlling JSON/HAR selection.
Mike (Eng): dev note: for large traces we should stream export to S3 and return a signed URL instead of bundling in response. avoids memory blowups.
Asha (Accessibility): another nit: tooltips used for stack frame file names must be exposed to screen readers (aria-describedby) and not rely on hover.
Sam (Product): nice catch. Also want an analytics event when support copies correlation ID (to measure how often support uses copy).
Anya (Design): copy tweaks: in the timeline hover card change "Start time" -> "Request start" and "Duration" -> "Latency (ms)" for clarity. Thoughts?
Mike (Eng): those labels are clearer. For latency we should show both ms and a friendly humanized value if >1s.
Asha (Accessibility): ensure units are announced to screen readers; include hidden text "milliseconds" after numeric value.
Sam (Product): decision: surface pill + copy, export modal with PII warning, keyboard accessibility fixes, and improved labels. Owner: Anya for design updates, Mike for API/export infra, Asha for accessibility signoff.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: design/err-analytics-v3 -> staging at 2026-03-23T03:00Z :rocket:
Anya (Design): I'll post updated prototype later today. If anyone has micro-copy suggestions ping me or drop inline comments on Figma. :sparkles:
Mike (Eng): will follow up with API contract and a sample export payload snippet:
```
GET /api/v1/traces/{trace_id}/export?format=json
Response: 202 Accepted
{ "export_id": "exp_123", "status_url": "/exports/exp_123" }
```
Sam (Product): perfect. thanks everyone — this covers the review.
Asha (Accessibility): thanks — will run the keyboard/accessibility pass after the design update.
